title: Average Color
description: Original native screen-driven GPU effect with persistent numeric state.
notes: Arithmetic HSL mean of 28x20 reduced cells, including non-circular hue averaging. Native tap gain multiplies by 0.95 per event, then recovers 0.025 per render. Qt smooth full-rectangle reduction is explicit; the proprietary engine.zone reduction is unavailable. Capture selection is shared infrastructure, not an extra artistic control. No source HTML or assets included.
